items.text: Thank you for playing Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles 2. In Ver. 1.81, balance adjustments have been made to the following characters.
Overall Gameplay Adjustments
Parrying
Increased stun duration of successful parries.
Guard Breaks
Increased stun duration of guard breaks.
Lowered the damage taken from combos after a guard break.
Aerial Attack (Plunge)
Now invulnerable to light attacks and throws on startup.
Supports
Support fighters whose actions have been interrupted after taking damage cannot be hit by additionally attacks.
